div.div: Boxes are TESPy nodes (power_plant.nodes); arrows are power_plant.edges. Single fluid loop (H2O, common.fluid_name) throughout -- each separator sends vapor (out2) to its turbine and liquid (out1) onward; condensate is remerged at condensate_mixer, brine and condensate at reinjection_mixer.

switch.text: Boxes are TESPy nodes (power_plant.nodes); arrows are power_plant.edges. Single fluid loop (H2O, common.fluid_name) throughout -- each separator sends vapor (out2) to its turbine and liquid (out1) onward; condensate is remerged at condensate_mixer, brine and condensate at reinjection_mixer.
